build_sync_ftrl_server: build a SyncFTRLServer instance with a global model and optional channel for DP federated learning
create_ftrl_server_config: create a SyncFTRLServerConfig dataclass with custom restart rounds, privacy settings, and aggregation type
run_ftrl_training_step: run a training step on the SyncFTRLServer to aggregate client updates and apply noisy FTRL optimization
select_clients_for_ftrl_training: select client user indices for the current FTRL training round using the active user selector
mock_ftrl_step_for_privacy: mock a SyncFTRLServer step to populate gradients with noisy sums for CANIFE empirical privacy measurement
